description: A hardcoded secret value (k8x#mP9...) was identified being validated directly against the apiKey query parameter within the Visitor Session module and portions of the WhatsApp controller. The issue was not found in design-cater or origin/main, suggesting it may already be resolved there.
recommendation: Move hardcoded secrets to environment variables, rotate exposed keys, and use timing-safe comparison methods for validation.

description: SupabaseDebugController was publicly accessible without AuthGuard, exposing database table listings and row-level data.
recommendation: Disable debug controllers in production environments or restrict access to administrators only.

line_note: Class has no @UseGuards on any branch checked
description: Multiple workspace and client metric endpoints lacked authentication protection, allowing data enumeration through known UUIDs across reviewed branches.
recommendation: Apply class-level AuthGuard protection along with tenant-level authorization checks for workspace resources.

description: Channel management APIs allowed create, list, update, and delete operations without proper authorization validation.
recommendation: Enforce authentication globally on channel management controllers using class-level guards.

issue_title: Visitor session IDOR and unauthenticated mutations
description: Visitor Session endpoints, including list, pagination, chatbot access, create, update, and delete actions, were accessible without authentication controls.
recommendation: Secure analytics and session queries by validating workspace access through JWT-scoped permissions.

issue_title: Public workspace by id and file download
description: Public workspace and download routes exposed sensitive workspace information due to unrestricted findOne service responses.
recommendation: Restrict public workspace responses to safe DTOs only and remove unnecessary sensitive fields from service responses.

line_note: design-cater: lines 8-9 @UseGuards(AuthGuard) PRESENT — not in affected list
issue_title: Chat logs controller missing AuthGuard (except design-cater after your push)
description: The stage, staging, production-test, and main branches were missing controller-level UseGuards protection, while the design-cater branch appeared secured after recent updates.
recommendation: Merge the hardened security implementation from the design-cater branch into stage, staging, production-test, and main.

description: In production-test and staging, WhatsApp handlers processed outbound messages and appended chats without validating x-whatsapp-send-response-secret or ConfigService checks.
recommendation: Reintroduce WhatsApp secret validation from secured branches and reject requests when secrets are missing in production.

description: File replacement functionality using multipart uploads and brandId values was accessible without authentication across tested branches.
recommendation: Remove unnecessary @Public access from sensitive endpoints and require JWT validation with ownership verification.

description: Workspace branding and configuration could potentially be modified if a valid workspace ID was known.
recommendation: Protect file replacement and upload operations with authenticated access controls.

description: Several endpoints accepted workspaceId and cookie-related values directly from request bodies without JWT validation.
recommendation: Restrict administrative and branding-related actions to authorized admin users only.

issue_title: Canned responses by URL workspaceId only
description: Full CRUD operations were accessible anonymously across multiple modules in reviewed branches.
recommendation: Enforce authentication checks across all CRUD endpoints handling sensitive resources.

line_note: UseGuards imported but no @UseGuards on class in grep
description: Meta/WhatsApp channel lifecycle management routes lacked enforced JWT authentication controls.
recommendation: Apply @UseGuards(AuthGuard) at the controller level for all exposed modules and APIs.

description: Findings were verified by comparing origin/design-cater, origin/stage, origin/staging, origin/production-test, and origin/main using git grep and git show. Reported line references are approximate and should be revalidated after merges.
recommendation: Re-run the complete security scan after merges and deployments to verify remediation coverage.
